title: Movie Ticket Booking (BookMyShow)
summary: Theatres, screens, shows with overlap checks, city search, seat-type pricing, hold → pay → confirm with an injected gateway, cancellation, and no double booking.
hints: Separate the catalogue (theatre, screen layout, movie) from the inventory (show, per-show seat status). `addShow` copies the screen's seat layout into per-show seat states.
Overlap on one screen: `start < otherEnd && otherStart < end`, where `end = start + duration`.
Reuse your seat-hold logic from Day 5: lazy TTL expiry, all-or-nothing, one lock per show.
`confirm`: check the hold is active, charge the gateway, and on failure release the seats **then** throw. On success mark the seats BOOKED and create the booking.
